subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Jonathan Swift was the greatest satirist in English literature. He was born in 1667 eight months after his father's death. He was educated in Trinity College. His "Gulliver's Travels" is a masterpiece in English literature. It appeared in 1726 and made him famous overnight. The last years of his life were full of sadness as he was mostly ill. He breathed his last three years after his stroke in 1742.
